name: eu-harmonized-standards-checker
description: EU Harmonized Standards Checker - Cloudflare Workers edition (static assets + Hono API + D1 scope database)

scripts.db:seed: npm run validate && node scripts/seed-from-md.mjs && wrangler d1 execute standards-checker --remote --file=seed/scopes.sql
scripts.db:seed:local: npm run validate && node scripts/seed-from-md.mjs && wrangler d1 execute standards-checker --local --file=seed/scopes.sql
scripts.setup:local: npm run db:migrate:local && npm run db:seed:local
